reason: Reason A makes the explanation legible through semantic sections without hiding it. Answers baseline offers the strongest continuous reading composition, though its legacy labels must not be mistaken for original question metadata. Check-in A preserves the exact forecast before clearer outcome choices. B's compactness helps at 200%, but disclosure costs matter when the hidden content is needed to make the decision. No composition demonstrates the authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold.
limitations: Reviewed only the six attached sheets, checks.json and public/concepts/expansion-30.html. No implementation, delegation, prior ratings or additional files were used.

Each screen score combines normal and 200% evidence. Component vectors use [hierarchy, typography, surfaces, clarity, feedback, accessibility]. Screen scores are holistic judgments, not component averages. A and F are calculated from unrounded dimension means; overall is rounded to one decimal.

Shared proposal components across A/B/C: brand header [7,7,8,7,null,7]; Back to forecast [8,8,8,8,null,7]; decorative bottom navigation [6,7,8,5,null,null]. The footer is aria-hidden, noninteractive spans in the supplied source: its navigation behavior is outside this prototype, not accessible navigation proof. Baseline close/account chrome [6,7,8,6,null,7]. No orb, input or modal is present.

Feedback numbers assess visible state indicators, affordances and recovery instructions only. They do not score unobserved interaction responsiveness. Null denotes passive reading or behavior outside the static proposal's scope; it does not mean an untested behavior passed.

checks.json records no horizontal overflow in all 18 alternative state/variant/text-size combinations. Source includes minimum 48px button/summary height and focus styling, but neither establishes actual keyboard or assistive-technology usability.

Fixed proposal footers reduce the visible reading area. Source includes bottom padding, so screenshots alone do not establish permanently obscured or unreachable content. No hard gate is proven by the visible crop.

Alternative navigation and outcome controls announce a layout study; no actual reading or outcome is saved. Saving is outside this composition comparison. These proposals cannot pass acceptance as delivered product flows.

Baseline runtime, contrast, reduced-motion and performance evidence was supplied by the user and not independently rerun. Alternative expanded, selected, loading, error, persistence, transition and keyboard states were not demonstrated here. Physical iPhone, VoiceOver and native behavior remain unverified separately from the browser composition grades.

Fixture repetition and abrupt endings are visible, but do not establish proposed content truncation. Reason A's semantic structure depends on producer-supplied roles; no migration exists. Answer numbering accurately acknowledges unavailable question metadata.
